review: The curve is broken for me. Saw Mill is stage 3 and kills the mid player in 2.1 seconds with saws at jump height right off the spawn; 27% pass there is a wall, not a lesson. Then Spring Loaded is 100 of 100 with zero deaths, so it is a cutscene with no line to optimise. Gauntlet stacks one laser at 67% that eats most runs, which reads as a timing lottery. First Steps left a player frozen before a small spike for 45 seconds. Crumble Bridge and Laser Gate are the good ones: readable hazards, real risk, fast flow.
best: Crumble Bridge and Laser Gate give fast, readable routes where a death is clearly my own mistake.
worst: Spring Loaded has no risk at all, while Saw Mill at stage 3 kills in two seconds before I can read the saw cycle.
